title: Erlang Fix Restores Certificate Checks Before TLS 1.3
caption:
Erlang/OTP 29.0.4 addresses a pre-TLS 1.3 certificate-validation bypass and denial-of-service weaknesses in certificate handling. Defenders must inventory runtimes, update complete dependency sets, and verify live component versions.
